versions.changelog:
Initial release for work-productivity-proactive-agent-workflow-helper:

- Provides practical support for Proactive Agent-style workflows on Clawhub, including bug fixes, setup hardening, and reliability improvements.
- Produces tailored workflows, checklists, or artifacts based on validated demand from agent users.
- Emphasizes local-hardware-friendly solutions (e.g., scripts, templates, CPU-safe workflows).
- Verifies outputs against user-defined success criteria, listing any remaining risks or follow-up actions.
- Designed to be actionable without needing the original source material; clarifies assumptions and required inputs.
